title: Maple Street Rising
author: Lena Underhill
blurb: Emrys Ravensworth, the new kid at a school built over something old, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
